proposals.title: Conditional backend choice and observed lift verification for open bowls
proposals.note: v01 selected a top_down candidate on 2/5 seeds, but both stopped at pre-grasp; the other 3/5 had no top_down candidate and the template's center fallback stalled on descent. v02's observed-geometry rim attempt reached pre-grasp on 5/5 and descended to within 0.010-0.011 m of commanded z on seeds 53-55, but every descent returned timeout before closure. Thus no run exercised object-lift verification or demonstrated a geometry grasp outperforming a backend grasp. The proposal's cited v07/v08 numbers were supplied in the proposal, not independently reproduced here.

gaps: The proposal qualifies backend selection but supplies no reproducible open-bowl rim pose, orientation, contact height, or acceptance rule for a near-base descent that reports timeout despite reaching within about 1 cm of commanded z.

The shared template's fallback aims at the bowl center. On seeds 51-53 it commanded z about 0.029 m and stopped near 0.082 m; retrying a geometry rim target in v02 did not resolve all scenes. A transferable skill needs a measured clearance and motion procedure before grasp/lift verification can be exercised.
No attempt reached release, so target placement height and landed-pose guidance remained unmeasured.
notes: Reading rules respected. v01 and v02 each passed 0/5; all ten runs completed and produced artifacts. The controller's initial v01 archive path error was repaired by packaging the already completed runs without rerunning them.
